thread.title: Goldman and Apple’s sinking stocks deliver a roughly 160-point blow to Dow

author: Stocks News Feed
title: Goldman and Apple’s sinking stocks deliver a roughly 160-point blow to Dow
text:
A combined drop in shares of Apple Inc.
 AAPL, -5.04%
 and Goldman Sachs Group Inc.
 GS, -7.46%
 were exacting a roughly 160-point toll in the Dow. The Dow Jones Industrial Average
 DJIA, -2.32%
 was down about 400 points in recent trade, with shares of those blue-chip names delivering the lion’s share of the pain for the price-weighted index. Goldman and Apple’s shares were down by at least 5%, at last check. A $1 move in any one of the Dow’s 30 components equates to a 6.8-point swing in the Dow. For example, Goldman’s 5.8% stock drop, or $12.82, represents a more than 85-point decline in the index.
